comment: wb-1xvp.3 (RF-GRAPH-POLICY-MACHINE-CONTROL-R2; the hk9l/5jha roster pattern, as wb-1xvp.4 uses it): the OUT-OF-FILE anchor of test/workbench-gp-control-loop-audit.test.ts. rows: every judged row of test/helpers/gp-control-loop-audit-cases.ts in table order (CALL_SITES, NOT_CALL_SITES, RESIDUALS, ANNOTATED, UNANNOTATED, FALSIFIERS, STAGES) - table, positional id, label and the SHA-256 of each pin as written (each input and each expectation). residuals: the named residual families, each a pinned quiet row. tests: every test the suite registers, in order. Written from the rows and the registered tests as measured at the cut; the suite judges its tables, its residual families and its registered tests (vitest task tree, run modes) against this file at test time, in order and both ways.
